name: lxst_audio
description: LXST voice capture/codec path vendored from pyxis (GPL-3.0). Hybrid build uses I2SCapture + Codec2Wrapper + filters + ring buffers only; lxst_audio.cpp (full-duplex orchestrator, depends on pyxis's Tone) and i2s_playback.cpp (would fight meshpunk's boot-installed I2S_NUM_0 driver — HYBRID_PLAN D4) are excluded from the build. Pins come from the local Hardware/TDeck/Config.h shim.
